title: In Memoriam: James, Baron of Kirkton
name: James Christopher Stevenson-Hamilton of Fairholm-Kirkton, Baron of Kirkton
text:
The Baronage of Scotland Association offers its sincere condolences to the family of The Much Honoured James Christopher Stevenson-Hamilton of Fairholm, Baron of Kirkton, who died on 23 September 2026, aged 93.

Known as Jamie, he was born in Pretoria on 21 May 1933, the only son of Lieutenant Colonel James Stevenson-Hamilton, the first warden of the Sabi Nature Reserve, now the Kruger National Park. He was the 17th of Fairholm. He was patron of the Stevenson-Hamilton Pipe Band, named in honour of his father.

His wife, Jennifer, died in 2025. They had three sons, James, Andrew and John. His eldest son, James, succeeds as 18th of Fairholm.

His funeral was held at Hamilton Old Parish Church on 9 October 2026.

May he rest in peace.
